This neuron is mostly a suppression unit: it goes strongly negative on word-internal sub-word continuation pieces of long brand/proper-name words (e.g. "-iz" in Optimizely, "-tron" in Extron, "-ess" in Quintessence, "-ing" in Polling), while its weak positive activations occur on the final whole word of a multi-word name or fixed compound and on the punctuation ending such a phrase (e.g. "Chain of Custody", "MANILA, Philippines", "debt ceiling", "Yard Dumpster", "Scottsbluff,").
